game.title: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors

roadmap.title: Open the Village and early dungeons
roadmap.description: Finish the tutorial, explore Mad Forest and Inlaid Library, and collect the relics that open Village services. Build card counters as you go.

roadmap.title: Explore the forests, libraries and dairy dungeons
roadmap.description: Clear the forest and library branches, cross Teeny Bridge, and explore Dairy Plant and Milk Factory. Rescue the Crawlers in coffins and collect each dungeon relic.

roadmap.title: Climb Gallo Tower and finish the chapel route
roadmap.description: Cross Weeny Bridge, explore Gallo Tower, and clear the chapel dungeons. Finish Curd Refinery and collect the remaining relics.

roadmap.title: Finish evolutions and remaining counters
roadmap.description: Replay open dungeons with the Crawlers and cards needed for any unfinished evolutions, level targets, gem unlocks and card counters.

achievements.description: Rescued Antonio in the average Italian countryside.
achievements.summary: Free Antonio from his coffin in the tutorial.

steps.text: Break @npc{Antonio’s coffin} during the @loc{Tutorial}.

achievements.description: Found these Pancakes in the Tutorial.
achievements.summary: Collect the Combo Stack in the tutorial.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Pancakes} along the @loc{Tutorial} route.

achievements.summary: Unlock crawler selection by reaching the Inn after the tutorial.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Tutorial} and enter the @loc{Inn} in the Village.
Explore @loc{Mad Forest} and collect the @item{Gem Hammer}. If you leave without the relic, replay Mad Forest.

achievements.summary: Reach level 10 during a dungeon run.

steps.text: Defeat enemies and collect their XP until your level reaches @mechanic{10} in one run.
Keep @item{Whip} and @item{Hollow Heart} in your deck. Leave a gem slot open on Whip.
Visit an @mechanic{Evolution statue} to receive an @item{Evolution gem}, then insert the gem into @item{Whip} to create @item{Bloody Tear}.

achievements.summary: Reach level 15 during a dungeon run.

steps.text: Defeat enemies and collect their XP until your level reaches @mechanic{15} in one run.
Pick up @item{coins} during dungeon runs until your collected total reaches @mechanic{250}.
Gather XP in @loc{Mad Forest} until you reach @mechanic{level 10}.
Explore @loc{Inlaid Library} and collect the @item{Guiding Light}. If you leave without the relic, replay Inlaid Library.

achievements.description: Reach Level 20 with Imelda Belpaese in Inlaid Library.
achievements.summary: In Inlaid Library, reach level 20 as Imelda Belpaese.

steps.text: Select @npc{Imelda Belpaese} at the @loc{Inn}. Reach @mechanic{level 20} in @loc{Inlaid Library}.

achievements.description: Reach a high Level with Pasqualina Belpaese.

steps.text: Equip @npc{Pasqualina Belpaese} at the @loc{Inn}, then gain XP to reach @mechanic{level 10} during a dungeon run.
Keep @item{Runetracer} and @item{Armor} in your deck. Leave a gem slot open on Runetracer.
Visit an @mechanic{Evolution statue} to receive an @item{Evolution gem}, then insert the gem into @item{Runetracer} to create @item{NO FUTURE}.
Include @item{Runetracer} in your deck and play Runetracer cards @mechanic{10 times}.

achievements.description: Find and play a Stone Mask.
achievements.summary: Find and play a Stone Mask card.

steps.text: Add a @item{Stone Mask} to your hand and play the card.
Beat the final boss in @loc{Mad Forest}, then use the boss chest to cash out. Replay Mad Forest after a failed run.

achievements.description: Defeat the Mantichana in Mad Forest.

steps.text: In @loc{Mad Forest}, defeat @enemy{Mantichana}. Replay Mad Forest if you leave before defeating Mantichana.
Use a deck containing @item{King Bible} and play King Bible cards @mechanic{99 times}.
Keep @item{Knife} and @item{Bracer} in your deck. Leave a gem slot open on Knife.
Visit an @mechanic{Evolution statue} to receive an @item{Evolution gem}, then insert the gem into @item{Knife} to create @item{Thousand Edge}.
Explore @loc{Furious Forest} and collect the @item{Polentír}. If you leave without the relic, replay Furious Forest.
Enter and play @mechanic{two dungeons} to open the @loc{Relic Museum} in the Village.

achievements.description: Play Fire Wand cards lots of times.

steps.text: Use @item{Fire Wand} throughout your dungeon runs until you have played Fire Wand cards @mechanic{100 times}.
Break @mechanic{20 light sources} while exploring dungeons.
Keep @item{Fire Wand} and @item{Spinach} in your deck. Leave a gem slot open on Fire Wand.
Visit an @mechanic{Evolution statue} to receive an @item{Evolution gem}, then insert the gem into @item{Fire Wand} to create @item{Hellfire}.

achievements.description: Gain lots and lots of Mana in a turn.

guide.context: Mana gained during the turn counts even when you spend Mana on cards.

steps.text: Prepare a hand with @npc{Arca} and @mechanic{three} @item{Ancient Tome} cards.

Play @npc{Arca} for 3 Mana, then play the three @item{Ancient Tome} cards before ending the turn. Each Tome costs 3 Mana and generates 4 Mana plus 1 from Arca, for @mechanic{18 Mana gained} in the turn.
Pick up @mechanic{two} @item{Mana Orbs} during your dungeon runs.

achievements.summary: Evolve Magic Wand into Holy Wand.

steps.text: Keep @item{Magic Wand} and @item{Empty Tome} in your deck. Leave a gem slot open on Magic Wand.
Visit an @mechanic{Evolution statue} to receive an @item{Evolution gem}, then insert the gem into @item{Magic Wand} to create @item{Holy Wand}.
Play @mechanic{purple mana cards} whenever useful until you have played @mechanic{100}.

achievements.description: Play Garlic cards lots of times.

steps.text: Include @item{Garlic} in your deck and play Garlic cards @mechanic{25 times}.
Equip @npc{Gennaro Belpaese} at the @loc{Inn}, then gain XP to reach @mechanic{level 10} during a dungeon run.
Break light sources and pick up @mechanic{five} @item{Floor Chickens}.
Keep @item{Garlic} and @item{Pummarola} in your deck. Leave a gem slot open on Garlic.
Visit an @mechanic{Evolution statue} to receive an @item{Evolution gem}, then insert the gem into @item{Garlic} to create @item{Soul Eater}.

achievements.summary: Reach level 25 during a dungeon run.

steps.text: Defeat enemies and collect their XP until your level reaches @mechanic{25} in one run.
Add @item{Peachone} to your deck and play the card during a fight.

achievements.summary: Unite Peachone and Ebony Wings into Vandalier.

steps.text: Keep @item{Peachone} and @item{Ebony Wings} in your deck. Leave a gem slot open on Peachone.
Visit an @mechanic{Evolution statue} to receive an @item{Evolution gem}, then insert the gem into @item{Peachone} to create @item{Vandalier}.
Defeat the final boss of @loc{Inlaid Library}, then open the boss chest and cash out. Replay Inlaid Library if the run fails.

achievements.summary: Find and play one Vacuum card.

steps.text: Pick up a @item{Vacuum} card and play the Vacuum.
Explore @loc{Library West Wing} and collect the @item{Grim Grimoire}. If you leave without the relic, replay Library West Wing.
Gain XP in @loc{Inlaid Library} until you reach @mechanic{level 15}.

achievements.description: Collect lots and lots of coins.

steps.text: Gather @item{coins} across dungeon runs until your collected total reaches @mechanic{5,000}.

achievements.summary: Evolve King Bible into Unholy Vespers.

steps.text: Keep @item{King Bible} and @item{Spellbinder} in your deck. Leave a gem slot open on King Bible.
Visit an @mechanic{Evolution statue} to receive an @item{Evolution gem}, then insert the gem into @item{King Bible} to create @item{Unholy Vespers}.
Explore @loc{Teeny Bridge} and collect the @item{Overkill}. If you leave without the relic, replay Teeny Bridge.
Explore @loc{Teeny Bridge} and collect the @item{Stardust Anvil}. If you leave without the relic, replay Teeny Bridge.

achievements.description: Complete a dungeon with 10% Curse or more.
achievements.summary: Clear a dungeon with at least 10% Curse.

steps.text: After clearing @loc{Weeny Bridge}, purchase one rank of @mechanic{Curse} from the @loc{Power Ups Shop} for 20% Curse.
Clear @loc{Mad Forest} with Curse active. Replay Mad Forest if the run fails.
Keep @item{Axe} and @item{Candelabrador} in your deck. Leave a gem slot open on Axe.
Visit an @mechanic{Evolution statue} to receive an @item{Evolution gem}, then insert the gem into @item{Axe} to create @item{Death Spiral}.
Equip @npc{Lama Ladonna} at the @loc{Inn}, then gain XP to reach @mechanic{level 30} during a dungeon run.
Play the @mechanic{green character cards} from your hand until you have used Crawler cards @mechanic{100 times}.
Defeat the boss of @loc{Teeny Bridge} and cash out from its chest. Retry Teeny Bridge if your run ends early.
Defeat the @enemy{Milk Elemental} in @loc{Dairy Plant}. If the run fails, try Dairy Plant again.
Break @item{Mine Carts} until your total reaches 5.

achievements.description: Play lots of Lightning Ring cards.

steps.text: Keep @item{Lightning Ring} cards in your deck and play them until the total reaches 100.
Defeat enemies across dungeon runs until your total reaches 2,500.

achievements.description: Play Magic Wand cards lots of times.

steps.text: Keep @item{Magic Wand} in your deck and play the card 25 times.

achievements.summary: Create Thunder Loop by evolving Lightning Ring.

steps.text: Have @item{Lightning Ring} and Duplicator or Du-Duplicator in your deck. Leave an empty gem slot on Lightning Ring.
Insert an @item{Evolution} gem into Lightning Ring to create @item{Thunder Loop}.

achievements.description: Activate lots and lots of Crawler trigger abilities.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Crawler} cards, then use the card colors named by their triggers to activate abilities until the total reaches 1,500.
Finish @loc{Furious Forest} by defeating the final boss and cashing out from its chest. Replay Furious Forest if you fail.
Defeat @enemy{Skeletons} until the total reaches 444.

achievements.description: Reach a high Level with Mortaccio.

steps.text: Start a dungeon run as @npc{Mortaccio} and collect XP until you reach Level 5. If the run ends too soon, start another run with Mortaccio.

achievements.description: Find the Coffin in Berserk Wood.
achievements.summary: Open the coffin in Berserk Wood.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Berserk Wood} and open the @item{coffin}. If you leave without opening the coffin, replay Berserk Wood.
Start a dungeon run as @npc{Krochi Freetto} and collect XP until you reach Level 20. If the run ends too soon, start another run with Krochi Freetto.

achievements.description: Reach a high Level with Pugnala Provola.

steps.text: Start a dungeon run as @npc{Pugnala Provola} and collect XP until you reach Level 15. If the run ends too soon, start another run with Pugnala Provola.

achievements.description: Reach a very high Level with Pugnala Provola.

steps.text: Start a dungeon run as @npc{Pugnala Provola} and collect XP until you reach Level 20. If the run ends too soon, start another run with Pugnala Provola.

achievements.description: Unite Eight The Sparrow and Phiera Der Tuphello.
achievements.summary: Create Phieraggi by uniting Eight The Sparrow with Phiera Der Tuphello.

steps.text: Keep @item{Eight The Sparrow}, @item{Phiera Der Tuphello}, and @item{Tirajisú} in your deck. Leave an empty gem slot on Eight The Sparrow.
Insert an @item{Evolution} gem into Eight The Sparrow to make @item{Phieraggi}.
Choose cards with @mechanic{Free-to-Play} and play them until your total reaches 150.
Beat the final boss in @loc{Library West Wing} and cash out from the boss chest. A failed run can be retried in Library West Wing.
Defeat @enemy{Lion Heads} until the total reaches 250.
Start a dungeon run as @npc{Yatta Cavallo} and collect XP until you reach Level 15. If the run ends too soon, start another run with Yatta Cavallo.

achievements.description: Find the Coffin in the Library Sanctum.
achievements.summary: Open the coffin in Library Sanctum.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Library Sanctum} and open the @item{coffin}. If you leave without opening the coffin, replay Library Sanctum.

achievements.description: Reach a high Level with Giovanna Grana.

steps.text: Start a dungeon run as @npc{Giovanna Grana} and collect XP until you reach Level 15. If the run ends too soon, start another run with Giovanna Grana.

achievements.summary: Create Vicious Hunger by evolving Gatti Amari.

steps.text: Have @item{Gatti Amari} and Stone Mask in your deck. Leave an empty gem slot on Gatti Amari.
Insert an @item{Evolution} gem into Gatti Amari to create @item{Vicious Hunger}.
Collect @item{Randomazzo} (Arcana Finder) in @loc{Library Sanctum}. If you miss the relic or the run fails, replay Library Sanctum.

achievements.summary: Build a deck containing at least 40 cards.

steps.text: Keep adding cards during one dungeon run until your @mechanic{deck size} reaches 40.
Beat the last boss in @loc{Dairy Plant} and cash out from the boss chest. Replay Dairy Plant after a failed attempt.
Collect @item{Bomba Infernale} in @loc{Dairy Plant}. If you miss the relic or the run fails, replay Dairy Plant.
Defeat enemies across dungeon runs until the total reaches 6,666.

achievements.description: Find and play a Rosary card.
achievements.summary: Find and play a Rosary card.

steps.text: Pick up a @item{Rosary} card and play the Rosary.

achievements.description: Find and play Little Clover cards.
achievements.summary: Play a total of 10 Little Clover cards that you find.

steps.text: Pick up @item{Little Clover} cards and play them until you have used 10.

achievements.summary: Create Heaven Sword by evolving Cross.

steps.text: Have @item{Cross} and Clover in your deck. Leave an empty gem slot on Cross.
Insert an @item{Evolution} gem into Cross to create @item{Heaven Sword}.
Play cards that grant @mechanic{Armor} across your dungeon runs until you have gained 2,000.
Gather XP during a @loc{Dairy Plant} run until you reach @mechanic{level 15}.

achievements.description: Recover lots and lots of HP.

steps.text: Restore missing HP during dungeon runs until you have recovered 1,000 HP.
Keep @item{Santa Water} in your deck and play the card 3 times.

achievements.summary: Create La Borra by evolving Santa Water.

steps.text: Have @item{Santa Water} and Attractorb in your deck. Leave an empty gem slot on Santa Water.
Insert an @item{Evolution} gem into Santa Water to create @item{La Borra}.
Clear @loc{Weeny Bridge} to open Gallo Tower. Retry Weeny Bridge if the run fails.
Collect @item{Lapidary Loupe} near the top in @loc{Gallo Tower}. If you miss the relic or the run fails, replay Gallo Tower.
Collect @item{Sorceress’ Tears} on the 5th floor in @loc{Gallo Tower}. If you miss the relic or the run fails, replay Gallo Tower.

achievements.summary: Defeat a total of 50 Dragon Shrimps in Gallo Tower.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Dragon Shrimps} in @loc{Gallo Tower} until the total reaches 50. Replay Gallo Tower if you need more.

achievements.description: Reach a high Level with O'Sole Meeo.
achievements.summary: Reach Level 30 while playing as O’Sole Meeo.

steps.text: Start a dungeon run as @npc{O’Sole Meeo} and collect XP until you reach Level 30. If the run ends too soon, start another run with O’Sole Meeo.

achievements.description: Find the Coffin in Gallo Tower.
achievements.summary: Open the coffin in Gallo Tower.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Gallo Tower} and open the @item{coffin}. If you leave without opening the coffin, replay Gallo Tower.
Start a dungeon run as @npc{Concetta Caciotta} and collect XP until you reach Level 15. If the run ends too soon, start another run with Concetta Caciotta.

achievements.summary: Reach Level 40 in a dungeon run.

steps.text: Collect XP in one dungeon run until your level reaches 40. Start another run if you finish or die before Level 40.

achievements.summary: Create Valkyrie Turner by evolving Shadow Pinion.

steps.text: Have @item{Shadow Pinion} and Wings in your deck. Leave an empty gem slot on Shadow Pinion.
Insert an @item{Evolution} gem into Shadow Pinion to create @item{Valkyrie Turner}.
Defeat @enemy{Gallo} in @loc{Gallo Tower}. Replay Gallo Tower if the run fails.

achievements.description: Find and play an Orologion card.
achievements.summary: Find and play an Orologion card.

steps.text: Pick up an @item{Orologion} card and play the Orologion.

achievements.description: Find and play the Pentagram card.
achievements.summary: Find and play a Pentagram card.

steps.text: Add @item{Pentagram} to your deck and play the card.

achievements.summary: Reach Level 35 in a dungeon run.

steps.text: Collect XP during one dungeon run until you reach Level 35. Start another run if you finish or die before Level 35.

achievements.summary: Create Gorgeous Moon by evolving Pentagram.

steps.text: Have @item{Pentagram} and Crown or Crystal Crown in your deck. Leave an empty gem slot on Pentagram.
Insert an @item{Evolution} gem into Pentagram to create @item{Gorgeous Moon}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Giant Enemy Crab in Gallo Tower.
achievements.summary: Kill Gallo Tower’s Giant Enemy Crab.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Gallo Tower} and defeat the @enemy{Giant Enemy Crab}. If you die before the kill, replay Gallo Tower.

achievements.summary: Reach a Combo of at least 12.

steps.text: Build a @mechanic{Combo} by playing cards in ascending Mana cost order until the combo counter reaches 12.
Defeat the last boss of @loc{Milk Factory}, then cash out using its chest. Retry Milk Factory if the run fails.

achievements.description: Find the Coffin in Milk Factory.
achievements.summary: Open the coffin in Milk Factory.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Milk Factory} and open the @item{coffin}. If you leave without opening the coffin, replay Milk Factory.

achievements.description: Reach a high Level with Poppea Pecorina.

steps.text: Start a dungeon run as @npc{Poppea Pecorina} and collect XP until you reach Level 30. If the run ends too soon, start another run with Poppea Pecorina.

achievements.summary: Create Mannajja by evolving Song of Mana.

steps.text: Have @item{Song of Mana} and Skull O’Maniac in your deck. Leave an empty gem slot on Song of Mana.
Insert an @item{Evolution} gem into Song of Mana to create @item{Mannajja}.

achievements.description: Find the Ultimate Ultra Overkill Relic.
achievements.summary: Find the Ultimate Ultra Overkill relic.

steps.text: Collect @item{Ultimate Ultra Overkill} in @loc{Curd Refinery}. If you miss the relic or the run fails, replay Curd Refinery.
Clear @loc{Meany Bridge} to open Cappella Magna. Retry Meany Bridge if the run fails.
Keep @mechanic{Wild} cards in your deck and play them until the total reaches 150.
Clear @loc{Cappella Magna} to open Cappella Ultima. Retry Cappella Magna if the run fails.

achievements.summary: Reach a combo of at least 7.

steps.text: Build a @mechanic{combo} of at least 7 by using cards from lower to higher Mana costs.

achievements.description: Reach a very very high Combo.
achievements.summary: Reach a combo of at least 12.

steps.text: Build a @mechanic{combo} of at least 12 by using cards from lower to higher Mana costs.

achievements.description: Reach a very very very high Combo.
achievements.summary: Reach a combo of at least 15.

steps.text: Build a @mechanic{combo} of at least 15 by using cards from lower to higher Mana costs.
After completing @loc{Cappella Ultima}, search the log just before the town during the credits and collect @item{Ovenkilt}. If you pass the log, replay Cappella Ultima.

achievements.description: Play lots and lots of cards picked up from light sources.
achievements.summary: Play 200 cards obtained from light sources.

steps.text: Move into light sources repeatedly to break them, and play the cards they drop until you have used 200 of these cards.
Find and defeat @enemy{Nesufritto} in @loc{Library West Wing}. If the run ends before the fight, replay Library West Wing.
Clear @loc{Curd Refinery} through the final encounter. If you lose the run, enter Curd Refinery again.
Clear @loc{Library Sanctum} through the final encounter. If you lose the run, enter Library Sanctum again.
Clear @loc{Berserk Wood} through the final encounter. If you lose the run, enter Berserk Wood again.

achievements.description: Gain lots and lots and lots of Mana in a turn.

steps.text: Take @npc{Arca} and add three @item{Ancient Tome} cards to your deck. Wait for a hand containing Arca and those three tomes.
Play Arca first, then play the three Ancient Tomes during that turn. Arca grants 3 Mana, the tomes generate 12, and Arca adds 3 more through purple-card triggers: 18 Mana gained.
Favor blue cards during dungeon runs and play them until your total reaches 250.

achievements.description: Play lots of Cherry Bomb cards.

steps.text: Use @item{Cherry Bomb} whenever drawn until you have played 50 Cherry Bomb cards.
Use @item{Crown} whenever drawn until you have played 5 Crown cards.
Use @item{Bone} whenever drawn until you have played 99 Bone cards.

achievements.description: Play lots of Empty Tome cards.

steps.text: Use @item{Empty Tome} whenever drawn until you have played 321 Empty Tome cards.

achievements.description: Play lots and lots of cards.

steps.text: Keep playing cards during dungeon runs until your total reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Deal lots and lots of damage.

steps.text: Keep attacking enemies in dungeon runs until your total damage reaches 666,666.

achievements.description: Play lots of cards picked up from light sources.
achievements.summary: Play 100 cards obtained from light sources.

steps.text: Move into light sources repeatedly to break them, and play the cards they drop until you have used 100 of these cards.

achievements.summary: Reach a combo of at least 5.

steps.text: Build a @mechanic{combo} of at least 5 by using cards from lower to higher Mana costs.
Use healing effects while injured until you have recovered 1,500 HP across your runs.
Use @item{Spellbinder} whenever drawn until you have played 10 Spellbinder cards.

achievements.description: Play lots and lots and lots and lots of cards.

steps.text: Keep playing cards during dungeon runs until your total reaches 3,000.

achievements.description: Play lots and lots of Free-to-Play cards.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{And Another} to make later copies of cards played that turn free, then play Free-to-Play cards until your total reaches 200.
Use @item{Clock Lancet} once after adding the card to your deck.
Use @item{Pummarola} whenever drawn until you have played 10 Pummarola cards.

achievements.description: Collect a vast fortune of coins.

steps.text: Collect coins during dungeon runs until your total reaches 100,000.

achievements.description: Deal lots and lots and lots of damage.

steps.text: Keep attacking enemies in dungeon runs until your total damage reaches 100,000.
Use @item{Clover} whenever drawn until you have played 5 Clover cards.
Use @item{Peachone} whenever drawn until you have played 77 Peachone cards.

achievements.description: Play lots and lots and lots of cards.

steps.text: Keep playing cards during dungeon runs until your total reaches 2,000.
Pick up @item{Mana Orbs} during dungeon runs until you have collected 10.

achievements.description: Collect lots and lots of Mana Orbs.

steps.text: Pick up @item{Mana Orbs} during dungeon runs until you have collected 20.

achievements.description: Collect lots and lots and lots of coins.

steps.text: Collect coins during dungeon runs until your total reaches 5,555.

achievements.description: Play lots and lots of purple cards.

steps.text: Favor purple cards during dungeon runs and play them until your total reaches 250.

achievements.description: Activate lots of Crawler trigger abilities.

steps.text: Play Crawler cards, then use the card colors named in their effects to activate their triggers until your total reaches 500.
Favor red cards during dungeon runs and play them until your total reaches 500.

achievements.description: Gain lots of Mana in a turn.

steps.text: Take @npc{Arca} and add three @item{Light Tome} cards to your deck. Wait for a hand containing Arca and those three tomes.
Play Arca first, then play the three Light Tomes during that turn. Arca grants 3 Mana, the tomes generate 6, and Arca adds 3 more through purple-card triggers: 12 Mana gained.

achievements.description: Destroy lots and lots of Mine Carts.

steps.text: Move into @item{Mine Carts} repeatedly to break them. Destroy 5 carts in total.

achievements.summary: Hold 7 cards in your hand at once.

steps.text: Use @item{Pasqualina} and play purple cards to raise Hand size. Draw enough cards to hold 7 at once; @item{Giovanna} can draw cards when you play purple cards.
Keep playing cards during dungeon runs until your total reaches 300.

achievements.summary: Reach a combo of at least 6.

steps.text: Build a @mechanic{combo} of at least 6 by using cards from lower to higher Mana costs.
Clear enemies during dungeon runs until your total kills reach 10,000.

achievements.description: Gain lots of Armor in a turn.

steps.text: Play Armor-granting cards during the same turn until you have gained 15 Armor.

achievements.summary: Hold 8 cards in your hand at once.

steps.text: Use @item{Pasqualina} and play purple cards to raise Hand size. Draw enough cards to hold 8 at once; @item{Giovanna} can draw cards when you play purple cards.
Collect coins during dungeon runs until your total reaches 3,333.

achievements.summary: Build a deck containing at least 30 cards.

steps.text: Keep adding cards during a dungeon run until your deck size reaches 30.

achievements.description: Find and play lots of Big Coin Bag cards.

steps.text: Pick up and play @item{Big Coin Bag} cards until you have used 20.
Keep attacking enemies in dungeon runs until your total damage reaches 500,000.
Play the same card repeatedly within one turn until the card cracks and breaks, drawing @enemy{The Trickster} to you.
Defeat The Trickster. If you lose the fight, summon The Trickster again in another run.

achievements.description: Play lots and lots of Wild cards.

steps.text: Favor Wild cards during dungeon runs and play them until your total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Play lots and lots and lots of purple cards.

steps.text: Favor purple cards during dungeon runs and play them until your total reaches 3,000.

achievements.summary: Complete Gallo Tower while playing as Gallo.

steps.text: Select @npc{Gallo} at the Inn, then clear @loc{Gallo Tower}. If the run fails, start Gallo Tower again as Gallo.
Favor yellow cards during dungeon runs and play them until your total reaches 250.
Use @item{Stone Mask} whenever drawn until you have played 10 Stone Mask cards.
